about: R6a part 2 worksheet: the source plate skills (hero_stone_skill_json, 228 texts at tiers 6/12/18) and stage-6 skill swaps (hero_slate_skill_json). Port each into the kit DSL like E3; English from _text where present.

skills.zh: 提升被【混乱】影响的目标30%物攻和特攻。
skills.en: Increases [Confused] targets' P.ATK and S.ATK by 30%.

skills.zh: 被【混乱】影响的目标还能使用小技能进行攻击。
skills.en: Targets affected by [Confusion] can still attack with basic skills.

skills.zh: 大招有20%几率减少目标所有怒气。
skills.en: Ultimate has a 20% chance to reduce target's all rage.

skills.zh: 大招降低防御效果提升至55%。
skills.en: Ultimate's damage reduction effect is increased to 55%

skills.zh: 大招每成功减少1个目标的防御，便获得7%伤害减免，持续3回合，最多3层。
skills.en: Every 1 targets whose DEF is reduced by your Ultimate, you gain 7% DMG Reduction for 3 turns. Stacks up to 3 times.

skills.zh: 大招必定降低目标防御。
skills.en: Ultimate is guaranteed to reduce target’s defense.

skills.zh: 大招会优先攻击血量最少的敌方单位所在的横排。
skills.en: Ultimate prioritizes the row with the enemy of lowest HP.

skills.zh: 大招出手前提升自身35%破防率和10%暴击率。
skills.en: Before using Ultimates, increase Guard Break Chance by 35% and Crit Chance by 10%

skills.zh: 大招对血量低于35%的敌人伤害提升30%
skills.en: Ultimate deals 30% additional damage to the enemies with less than 35% HP

skills.zh: 鲤鱼王会优先攻击后排单位。普通攻击和小技能会额外偷取敌方12.5%怒气。
skills.en: Magikarp prioritizes backline units. Basic attacks and basic skills additionally steal 12.5% Rage from enemies.

skills.zh: 大招对【技】宠伤害提升25%。
skills.en: Increase Ultimate's damage against [SKILL] Pokémons by 25%.

skills.zh: 大招伤害加深效果提升至25%，持续回合提升至4回合。
skills.en: Increases Ultimate's DMG Multiplier to 25%. Lasts 4 turn(s).

skills.zh: 无视防御效果提升至25%，提升攻击效果无法被驱散。
skills.en: Boosts the Ignore DEF effect to 25%. The ATK boost cannot be dispelled.

skills.zh: 提升攻击效果提升至15%。
skills.en: Increases ATK boost effect to 15%.

skills.zh: 使用大招后回复自身25%怒气。
skills.en: Regenerate 25% Rage after using Ultimate.

skills.zh: 大招对【攻】宠伤害提升30%，对【技】宠伤害提升10%。
skills.en: Increase Ultimate's damage against [ATK] Pokémons by 30%, against [SKILL] Pokémons by 10%.

skills.zh: 大招会降低目标20%控制抵抗，持续2回合，最多1层。
skills.en: Ultimate reduces target's Control Res by 20% for 2 turns. Stacks up to 1 times.

skills.zh: 大招攻击已被控制目标时，自身怒气回复效果提升至25%，并有35%几率减少目标25%怒气。
skills.en: When using Ultimate upon controlled targets, increase Rage regeneration to 25%, with 35% chance to reduce target's Rage by 25%.

skills.zh: 大招伤害提升20%，【麻痹】几率提升至23%。
skills.en: Increase Ultimate damage by 20% and [Paralysis] chance to 23%.

skills.zh: 小技能伤害提升25%，【麻痹】几率提升至35%。
skills.en: Increase basic skill damage by 25% and [Paralysis] chance to 35%.

skills.zh: 大招攻击目标+1。
skills.en: Ultimate's target +1

skills.zh: 大招攻击后为目标施加【易伤】，增加10%目标受到的伤害，持续1回合，最多1层。
skills.en: Ultimate inflicts [Vulnerability] on targets, increasing the damage they take by 10% for 1 turns. Stacks up to 1 times.

skills.zh: 大招出手前提升自身10%暴击率，拥有【力量代价】时，友方后排暴击率提升效果提升至18%。
skills.en: Before using Ultimate, increase your Crit Chance by 10%. When [Offer of Power] is active, increases backline allies' Crit Chance to 18%.

skills.zh: 拥有【力量代价】时，大招对【防】宠伤害提升25%。
skills.en: When [Offer of Power] is active, increase Ultimate's damage against [DEF] Pokémons by 25%.

skills.zh: 大招物攻伤害减免提升至30%，额外提升15%特攻伤害减免。
skills.en: Increases Ultimate's P.ATK DMG Reduction by 30%, plus 15% S.ATK DMG Reduction.

skills.zh: 使用大招后为友方后排施加【护盾】，吸收杰尼龟最大生命值12%的伤害，可与其他【护盾】相互叠加；同时提升友方后排12%物攻和特攻，持续3回合，最多1层。
skills.en: Ultimate gives backline allies a [shield] for 12% of Squirtle's max HP. Stacks with other [shields]; Increases backline allies' P.ATK and S.ATK by 12% for 3. Stacks up to 1 times.

skills.zh: 大招为敌方目标施加【愈合印记】，持续2回合，最多1层，友方攻击【愈合印记】标记的目标时回复杰尼龟最大生命值3%的血量。
skills.en: Ultimate inflicts [Regrowth Mark] upon enemies for 2 turns. Stacks up to 1 times. The allies who attack the target marked with [Regrowth Mark] will heal Squirtle for 3% of max HP.

skills.zh: 大招提升至必定叠加2层【中毒】，并有60%几率额外叠加1层。
skills.en: Ultimate enhanced. Now it's guaranteed to inflict 2 stacks of [Poison], with 60% chance to gain additional 1 stacks.

skills.zh: 大招攻击范围提升至全体敌方单位
skills.en: Increases Ultimate’s range to all enemies

skills.zh: 大招提升必定叠加3层【中毒】，并有80%几率额外叠加1层。
skills.en: Ultimate is guaranteed to gain 3 stacks of [Poison], with 80% chance to gain additional 1 stacks.

skills.zh: 大招基础伤害提升15%，附加伤害提升至目标已损失生命值12%。
skills.en: Increases Ultimate's base damage to 15%, increases bonus damage to 12% of target's missing HP.

skills.zh: 大招攻击时无视目标40%特防。
skills.en: Ultimate ignores target's 40% S.DEF.

skills.zh: 大招优先攻击血量最低的敌方单位。
skills.en: Ultimate prioritizes the enemies with lowest HP.

skills.zh: 【识破】伤害提升25%，额外附加30%目标特攻的真实伤害。
skills.en: Increases [Foresight] damage by 25%, plus true damage equal to 30% of target's S.ATK.

skills.zh: 【识破】持续回合数+1。
skills.en: [Foresight] lasts +1

skills.zh: 【识破】无法被净化。
skills.en: [Foresight] cannot be cleansed.

skills.zh: 【恶性创口】效果提升至使目标受到的持续伤害提升30%。
skills.en: Boosts [Malignant Wounds] effect. Target now takes 30% more damage over time.

skills.zh: 【恶性创口】效果会额外降低目标12%特攻。
skills.en: The [Malignant Wounds] effect further reduces target's S.ATK by 12%

skills.zh: 大招对被除【出血】以外的其他持续伤害影响的敌人伤害提升30%。
skills.en: Ultimate deals 30% increased damage to the enemies affected by DoT ([Bleed] excluded).

skills.zh: 大招如果没有被目标格挡，则附加目标当前生命值12%的真实伤害。
skills.en: If the ultimate is not blocked by target, inflicts upon target true damage equal to 12% of target's current HP.

skills.zh: 大招暴击时附加目标已损失生命值12%的真实伤害。
skills.en: When the Ultimate crits, inflicts upon target true damage equal to 12% of target's missing HP.

skills.zh: 普通攻击如果没有被目标格挡，则附加目标当前生命值8%的真实伤害；小技能暴击时附加目标已损失生命值8%的真实伤害。
skills.en: If a basic attack is not blocked by target, inflicts upon target true damage equal to 8% of target's current HP; When basic skills crit, inflict true damage equal to 8% of target's missing HP.

skills.zh: 使用大招后自身获得15%物攻伤害减免，持续2回合，最多1层；同时降低敌方目标10%破防率，持续2回合，最多1层。
skills.en: After using Ultimates, gain 15% P.ATK DMG Reduction for 2 turns. Stacks up to 1 times; Reduce enemy target's Guard Break Chance by 10% for 2 turns. Stacks up to 1 times.

skills.zh: 【守护】分担率提升至40%。
skills.en: [Protection] Increases splitting rate to 40%.

skills.zh: 使用大招后为自己和自身站位上方的友方目标施加【护盾】，吸收自身最大生命值10%的伤害，可与其他【护盾】相互叠加。

skills.zh: 大招基础治疗量提升18%，攻击被持续伤害影响的敌人时的治疗量提升效果提升至30%。
skills.en: Increases Ultimate's basic healing amount by 18%. When attacking the enemies affected by  [DoT], increases the healing boost to 30%.

skills.zh: 大招会驱散敌方目标1个增益效果，并净化友方目标身上的所有负面效果。
skills.en: Ultimate dispels 1 buffs from enemies and cleanses all status ailments from allies.

skills.zh: 大招会增加自身站位下方的友方目标50%怒气。
skills.en: Ultimate increases the Rage of the ally below your position by 50%.

skills.zh: 使用大招后获得10%伤害加深和伤害减免，持续5回合，最多3层。
skills.en: After using the Ultimate, gain 10% DMG Multiplier and DMG Reduction for 5 turns. Stacks up to 3 times.

skills.zh: 【愈合】效果提升至回复自身5%最大生命值的血量。
skills.en: Increases [Regrowth] effect to regenerating 5% of max HP

skills.zh: 使用普通攻击和小技能后有50%几率获得【缓慢愈合】，每回合回复自身2%最大生命值的血量，持续3回合，最多1层，可与【愈合】同时生效。
skills.en: Using basic attacks and basic skills comes with 50% chance to gain [Regrowth over Time], healing for 2% of max HP per turn over 3 turns. Stacks up to 1 times. Can be stacked with [Regrowth].

skills.zh: 大招驱散效果个数+1。
skills.en: Ultimate dispels +1

skills.zh: 使用大招后净化自身站位上方的友方目标身上的所有负面效果。
skills.en: After using Ultimates, cleanse all status ailments from the allies above you.

skills.zh: 大招有35%几率减少敌方目标25%怒气。
skills.en: Ultimate has 35% chance to reduce target's Rage by 25%.

skills.zh: 大招【眩晕】几率提升至25%，降低控制抵抗效果提升至20%。
skills.en: Increases Ultimate's [Stunning] chance to 25%. Boosts Control Res Reduction effect to 20%.

skills.zh: 大招对被控制的目标额外降低20%控制抵抗，持续2回合，最多1层，同时降低20%暴击率和8%暴击强度，持续3回合。
skills.en: Ultimate further reduces controlled target's Control Res by 20% for 2 turns. Stacks up to 1 times. Reduces their Crit Chance by 20% and Crit Intensity by 8% for 3 turns.

skills.zh: 使用大招后提升友方前排18%伤害减免，持续2回合，最多1层。
skills.en: After using Ultimates, increase allied frontline's DMG Reduction by 18% for 2 turns. Stacks up to 1 times.

skills.zh: 自身每减少1%血量，大招吸血倍率就提升0.5%。
skills.en: Every 1% missing HP increases Ultimate's Lifesteal multiplier by 0.5%.

skills.zh: 大招对血量低于35%的目标伤害提升35%。
skills.en: Ultimate deals 35% additional damage to targets with less than 35% HP

skills.zh: 普通攻击和小技能会偷取目标8%物攻，持续5回合，最多1层。
skills.en: Basic attacks and basic skills steal 8% P.ATK from target for 5 turns. Stacks up to 1 times.

skills.zh: 普攻和小技能对【防】宠额外伤害提升至50%

skills.zh: 若大招没有击杀目标，大回合结束时对目标造成已损失生命值15%的真实伤害，该伤害击杀目标不算做大招的击杀

skills.zh: 大招后获得【力量代价】，扣除20%当前生命值，满怒并提升大招50%伤害1回合，冷却时间4回合，不可驱散

skills.zh: 大招基础伤害提升15%，附加伤害提升至目标当前生命值10%

skills.zh: 大招出手前提升自身15%暴击率和8%暴击伤害，大招基础伤害再提升20%
